reviewer: Pickle: official-source review of the Korea Consumer Agency comparison report 2017-2 on electric heating pads (19 products), the 2023 MOTIE/KATS recall notice, and the three Coupang listings opened live on 2026-11-19
method: Compared the draft against the Korea Consumer Agency comparison report page (consumer.go.kr, published 2017-01-23) and its per-product result tables read on 2026-11-19: the 18-vendor 19-product sample (9 heat-storage, 10 corded), the 2016-06 survey of 1,000 adults, the 2016-07 purchase prices (21,620 to 75,000 won), the surface temperature standard of 85 degrees for heat-storage pads and 85 degrees within two hours plus 50 degrees after two hours for corded pads under K 10020 and KC 60335-2-17, the nine heat-storage surface maxima (65/67/70/75/79/92/95/98/100), the ten corded pairs (within two hours 61-83, after two hours 39-76) with three failures (62, 76, 68), the 4:26-7:02 charge times, 116-202 minute retention times, 25-64 Wh and 25-59 Wh energy use, all-pass electrical and mechanical results, and the seven vendors' stop-sale and refund replies. The Sun product being a licensed medical warmer with a 70 plus or minus 5 degree standard is stated in the article. The 2023 figures (65 items, 1,018 products, 45 recalls, 5 electric heating pads, PR-01 at 140 degrees against a 120 degree limit, WGT-1002 at 101.2 degrees against 85) come from the consumer.go.kr recall notice of 2023-12-28 and the Yonhap report of 2023-12-12. Annual electricity figures were recalculated from the agency's Wh values at 160 won per kWh with the assumption written in the body. Coupang was checked in the signed-in browser on 2026-11-19: Shinhwa SCM-800ST at 44,500 won with 97 reviews and KC HA07118-6007A, Jespah SHP6751 at 35,400 won with 16,100 reviews and KC HH07976-18009K, and Dr.well HDW-172 at 33,830 won with 806 reviews and KC HU071848-19002B. The two AFFSDP deep links tested (SCM-800ST, SHP6751) landed on the intended models with lptag AF6593875. The article says where a listing differs from the tested item: only SCM-800ST is the same model, and both other products are not test subjects. The affiliate box sits only at the bottom after the FAQ, with no top, inline or sticky box, per the 2026-11-17 approval-first layout.
renewalNote: 7일 검증 갱신 2026-11-25 08:00 KST (피클 정기 발행 루틴). 근거: 본문(md)과 조사 기록(json) 해시가 직전 승인본과 동일해 문구·수치를 바꾸지 않았다. 인용 출처 6곳 가운데 3곳이 200 응답를 확인했고, 쿠팡 상품·일부 학술지·판매처 3곳는 자동 요청 차단 또는 리다이렉트로 응답 본문을 받지 못해 수치는 이전 확인값을 그대로 둔다. 본문 수치와 출처 내용의 불일치는 새로 발견하지 못했다.
